content: पच् I. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (पचति-ते, पपाच-पेचे, आपक्षीत्-अपक्त, पक्ष्यति-ते, पक्तुम्, पक्व) .²1 To cook, roast, dress (as food <ab>&c.</ab>) (said to govern two accusatives; as तण्डुलानोदनं पचति, but this use is very rare in classical Sanskrit); यः पचत्यात्मकारणात् <ls>Ms. 3. 118</ls>; शूले मत्स्यानिवापक्ष्यन् दुर्बलान् बलवत्तराः <ls n="Ms.">7. 20</ls>; <ls>Bh. 1. 85</ls>. .²2 To bake, burn (as bricks); see पक्व .²3 To digest (as food); पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् <ls>Bg. 15. 14</ls>. .²4 To ripen, mature, .²5 To bring to perfection, develop (as understanding). .²6 To melt (as metals). .²7 cook (for oneself) (<ab>Ātm.</ab>). --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (पच्यते) .²1 To be cooked. .²2 To become ripe, matured or developed, ripen; (<ab>fig.</ab>) to bear fruit, attain perfection or fulfilment; सद्य एव सुकृतां हि पच्यते कल्पवृक्षफलधर्मि काङ्क्षितम् <ls>R. 11. 50</ls>. .²3 To be inflamed. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 (पाचयति -ते) To cause to be cooked, to have cooked or dressed (food <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 To cause to ripen or develop, bring to maturity, perfection, or completion. .²3 To cure, heal. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (पिपक्षति) To wish to cook <ab>&c.</ab> --{%With%} परि to ripen, mature, develop. {@वि˚@} .²1 To mature, develop, ripen, bear fruit; गर्भशालिसधर्माणस्तस्य गूढं विपेचिरे <ls>R. 17. 53</ls>. .²2 To digest. .²3 To cook thoroughly. --II. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पचते) To make clear or evident; see (पञ्चते) also. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To explain fully, dilate upon, amplify. .²2 To spread.
पच् {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Cooking, baking <ab>&c.</ab>
